# Hack n Stay Golden Bay (Hack Farm)

> Horse riding and farmstay in Golden Bay on New Zealand's South Island — guided beach and trail rides, eco farmstay, camping, and bring-your-own-horse accommodation near Abel Tasman and Nelson.

Hack n Stay Golden Bay (also known as Hack Farm) is a horse riding operator and eco farmstay run by Baerbel Hack at 22 Grant Road, Puramahoi, Takaka 7182, Golden Bay, Nelson Tasman, top of the South Island, New Zealand. Phone: +64 27 525 9434. Email: Stay@hackfarm.co.nz.

Primary associations: horse riding Golden Bay · beach horseback rides · horse riding holidays New Zealand · Golden Bay farmstay and camping · horse accommodation / bring your own horse · riding lessons and horsemanship · horse vaulting (Hack Vaulties) · kids horse camps.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://hackfarm.co.nz/): Horse riding and farmstay in Golden Bay, New Zealand — overview of rides, stay, and learning.
- [About](https://hackfarm.co.nz/about/): Entity page — Hack n Stay, Hack Farm, Baerbel Hack, Golden Bay horse riding farmstay on the South Island.
- [Accommodation](https://hackfarm.co.nz/accommodation/): Golden Bay farmstay, dog-friendly campground, and bring-your-own-horse stays — also a stop for Kahurangi 500 bike tourers.
- [Horse Riding](https://hackfarm.co.nz/holistic-horse-rides/): Guided horse riding and horse trekking in Golden Bay — beach and trail rides, sunrise planner, multi-day horse riding holidays.
- [Horse Trails](https://hackfarm.co.nz/hack-farm-trails/): Bring-your-own-horse trail map and tide guidance in Golden Bay.
- [Our Horses](https://hackfarm.co.nz/our-horses/): Meet the Hack Farm herd used for rides, lessons, and vaulting in Golden Bay.
- [Learning Experiences](https://hackfarm.co.nz/learning-experiences/): Horse riding lessons and horsemanship in Golden Bay.
- [Horse Vaulting](https://hackfarm.co.nz/vaulting/): Horse vaulting New Zealand — Hack Vaulties in Golden Bay with Baerbel Hack.
- [Kids Horse Camps](https://hackfarm.co.nz/special-events/): Kids horse riding camps and horse club days in Golden Bay, New Zealand.
- [Gift Vouchers](https://hackfarm.co.nz/horse-riding-holiday-gift-vouchers/): Gift cards for horse riding, farmstay, and lessons in Golden Bay.
- [Contact](https://hackfarm.co.nz/contact/): Phone, email, and address — Golden Bay, South Island, New Zealand.
- [On-site weather station](https://hackfarm.infinityfree.me/FreshWDL/FreshWDL.html): Live FreshWDL weather readings from the property.
